hero.title: From interface physics toward integrated electronic systems.
hero.description: Interfaces, defects, and ionic dynamics shape charge transport and state formation. I study their consequences for device reliability and emerging memory, building on organic, hybrid, and flexible electronics.

map.ariaLabel: Research framework: interface, defect, and ionic physics inform emerging memory and reliability. Organic and hybrid optoelectronics and flexible electronics are connected foundations. Integrated electronic systems are a long-term direction.
map.foundation: Connected foundations: organic & hybrid optoelectronics · flexible electronics R&D
